slug: 2026-01-21 Somalia seeks to strengthen national ID system through Pakistan partnership

systems.owner: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA), established and made operational with help from Pakistan's NADRA

note: The document reports talks in Islamabad (about 20-21 January 2026, a proxy date) between Somalia's interior minister, NIRA's Director General and NADRA on the national identification system. Its one use of 'civil registry' describes NIRA as a cornerstone of building a unified one; it states nothing about the registration of births or deaths or about any registry office.
